company: Willow Tree Acres Horse Retirement Farm

reviews.text: I had ny horse Magic cared for by Willow Tree Acres for years until my baby passed. She had carte blanche treatment in all of her final years. I am so thankful I found Henry Stoltzfus to care for my beloved Magic. Deborah Johnson
reviews.author: Deborah J.

reviews.text: I needed a safe place for my blind horse to enjoy his retirement. I couldn't be happier with his care. They take care of everything, including setting up vet visits. I don't have to worry about the farrier, feed, etc.
reviews.author: Brenda K.
